title: GeoPyMPM Stage 7 objective stress rotation verification

corotational.name: Stage 7 prescribed rigid spin (corotational)
corotational.notes: All nodal velocities prescribed; verifies stress objectivity in a full solver step. Stage-3D F and G2P positions still use forward Euler, so J and continuum rotation trajectory drift by O(dt). A non-objective legacy comparison is expected NOT to pass.
